test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On 27 July 2022, the Union Cabinet cleared a Rs. 1.64 lakh crore package for the revival of which of the following organisations?

options.text: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On July 27, **the Union Cabinet authorized a 1.64 lakh crore package** for the rehabilitation of the state-owned telecom provider **Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL),** in yet another attempt to bring it back to life.
 
• The package will include the administrative allotment of **4G spectrum worth 44,993 crores**, which contains **a cash component worth 43,964 crores** and a non-cash component worth** 1.2 lakh crores** spread over four years. The ambitious Bharat Net project's implementation vehicle, **Bharat Broadband Network Ltd (BBNL), **would also be amalgamated into BSNL.
 
• **Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited, also known as BSNL**, is an Indian central public sector organization with its headquarters in New Delhi. The owner is the Department of Telecommunications within the **Ministry of Communications of the Government of India**. The Indian government formally incorporated it on October 1st, 2000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Air India**

 
 
• **​**With an **18.6% market share, Air India dominates the Indian international aviation industry.**
 
• More than 60 foreign locations on four continents are served by Air India. As the 27th member of **Star Alliance**, the airline joined on July 11, 2014. The airline was started by **J. R. D.**
 
 
 
• **Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR)**
 
 
• ​The **Container Corporation of India Ltd. (CONCOR)** was established in March 1988 in accordance with the Companies Act, and it started operating in November 1989 after assuming control of the Indian Railways' previous network of seven ICDs.
 
• **CONCOR **is dedicated to offering its clients responsive, affordable, effective, and dependable logistics solutions. It aspires to be the top option for its clients. Customer satisfaction, performance, and results are the top priorities at **CONCOR, **which is committed to giving its clients value for their money.
 
 
 
• **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited**
 
 
• **​**The **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India**, is the owner of the** Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC),** a central public sector organization. Its main office is in New Delhi. The Indian government formed ONGC on August 14, 1956.
 
• It is the largest government-owned oil and gas explorer and producer in the nation and produces over 84% of India's natural gas and about 70% of its crude oil, which corresponds to around 57% of the nation's total consumption.
 
• **The Indian government granted ONGC the Maharatna designation in November 2010.**
